title: Fix the large findings, part 1, from the notes sort
why: Item 355 sort, coordinator 14:05 CST Nov 7: 9 Sonnet agents sorted 1,629 notes and debts on main 174b005c1. Fix 184 (166 small, 18 large), delete 86, keep 1,359 (146 of them unverified). Lists: branch claude/clever-planck-oynpfh 759486de5, docs/plans/notes-sort/.
note: Its list is in docs/plans/notes-sort/ on branch claude/clever-planck-oynpfh. Each lane carries the tag cs-step:notes-fix-large-1. Coordinator pick, 14:11 CST Nov 7 (the owner may overturn it), for debt finished-agent-shells-keep-tree: the agent-end reap may free a host-locked worktree once the worktree is pushed, idle for 30 minutes, and its agent is absent from the stop event's background tasks. The reap stops that agent's shells, then removes the worktree. Based on the owner's ruling of 2026-10-15 19:43 CDT and his 13:41 CST note on page item 357. Page item 364 (14:14 CST) asks the owner whether the silent-undo check may pass reworded lines, for row inplace-edit-under-0-9-flagged. Coordinator pick, 14:27 CST Nov 7 (undoable), for row known-defects-install-false-red (#1453): a defect needs a part's install only when that part's code or tests regex claims it, and an unclaimed defect needs every install. No hole opens. Joyous's one-install profile stays exposed, recorded as a debt. Coordinator pick, 14:43 CST, #1479 (debt finished-agent-shells-keep-tree), replacing the 14:11 pick: a finished agent's shells stop only when its own SubagentStop row exists and its transcript has been idle 30 min. The reviewer measured 64 of 213 running agents unlisted, with quiet gaps up to 16.2 min, so the 14:11 rule (unlisted + idle 30 min) could have killed a live agent. Orphan shells keep the tree, as on main. Item 364 a is row 6 (silent-undo in-place edit), not #1479 (row 5, agent-end reap). Row 6 waits for PR #1099 (refuse a lane commit that undoes its own lane's work) to merge, per the coordinator's 14:15 CST ruling. Coordinator pick, 15:05 CST, #1479 row 5: a shell in a finished agent's tree is stopped only when it is shown to be that agent's own, keeping the owner's 2026-10-15 19:43 CDT ruling. #1479 lands only the unlock-and-remove half (a finished tree with no process inside). Debt finished-agent-shells-keep-tree stays open with Fix: step:agent-process-marker. #1799 replaces #1453; #1453 closes when #1799 merges (coordinator, 00:29 CST Nov 8).
